response.headline: Intel to buy back Apollo stake in Ireland factory for $14.2 billion
response.summary: Intel said it would spend $14.2 billion to buy back the 49% stake it had sold to Apollo Global Management in ‌its Ireland manufacturing facility, taking full ownership of the plant as its ‌finances improve and AI drives demand for its processors.  Apollo had paid $11.2 billion in 2024 to acquire the stake in a joint venture related to the plant in the town of Leixlip outside Dublin, giving the then-struggling Intel a cash infusion to fund its manufacturing expansion in Europe and the ‌United States.  Intel has since changed ⁠CEOs, with current top boss Lip-Bu Tan pursuing an aggressive restructuring to repair the company's finances, including job cuts and asset ⁠sales.
